trail.text: That disk surge is extreme — checking if it's isolated or spreading.
The spike starts exactly at the flag — now tracing whether travel is the source or a victim.
Downstream dependencies look healthy — now checking upstream callers for collateral impact.
Upstream delays are lining up — gathering final proof to rank the causes.
Four victims mapped — pulling final confirmation before the verdict.

causes.reasoning: DiskIO steps from ~51k to ~13.3B at flag (0s) with CPU 9.2->29.5 and API latencies 3x, while all callees (train, route, ticketinfo) and travel-mongo stay flat, proving origin not victim.
Direct caller of travel-service whose trip-food lookup p50 rose 44ms->64ms and overall latency 0.089->0.195 starting 39s after flag, classic downstream victim.
Calls travel-service and its preserve POST p50 doubled 552ms->1068ms with latency 1.17->1.99 and diskio/cpu up, consistent with waiting on sick travel-service.
Heavy caller of travel-service (4247 calls) with overall latency 0.108->0.175 and tail p95 21ms->92ms while its own DB not implicated, indicating propagated queuing.
Admin frontend that only calls travel/travel2 shows latency 0.315->0.563 first exceeding at 51s after travel's 13s spike, confirming downstream impact ordering.
